nodes.description: uint256 public id - ERC1155 token id being auctioned
address public token - ERC1155 token contract address
bool public ended - auction finalization flag
uint256 public startBidTime - auction start timestamp
address payable public haus - fee recipient
address payable public seller - auction seller
uint256 public bidLength - duration of a single bid window
uint256 public auctionLength - total auction duration
uint256 public lastBid - amount of current winning bid
uint256 public lastBidTime - timestamp of current winning bid
address payable public winning - current highest bidder
constructor() sets token, id, startBidTime, lastBid, seller and haus
bid() public payable - accepts bids, refunds previous winner and records new highest bid
end() public - transfers ERC1155 to winner and distributes ETH to haus and seller
pull() public - returns ERC1155 to seller when no bids were placed
live() external view - returns true while the auction is still running
onERC1155Received(...) external pure - ERC1155 receiver hook returning the selector
msg.sender - caller of bid/end/pull, becomes the new winning bidder
block.timestamp - used for all auction timing checks
tx.origin - used in bid() to reject contract callers
winning.transfer(lastBid) - ETH send to previous winner inside bid() before state is updated
IERC1155(token).safeTransferFrom(address(this), winning, id, 1, ...) in end() - external call that can invoke receiver hook
haus.transfer(hausFee) in end() - ETH send to fee recipient
seller.transfer(address(this).balance) in end() - ETH send of remaining balance to seller
IERC1155(token).safeTransferFrom(address(this), seller, id, 1, ...) in pull() - external call that can invoke receiver hook
lastBid.mul(105).div(100) - minimum bid arithmetic inside bid()
balance.div(20).mul(3) - fee arithmetic inside end()
uint256 balance in end() - contract balance prior to payout
uint256 hausFee in end() - computed 3/20 fee amount

edges.reason: constructor writes the token state variable
constructor writes the id state variable
constructor writes the startBidTime state variable
constructor sets the initial lastBid value
constructor sets the seller address
constructor sets the haus address
msg.sender is the caller of bid()
tx.origin is compared with msg.sender inside bid() to reject contract callers
block.timestamp drives the start/end window checks in bid()
msg.sender is assigned to the winning state variable
block.timestamp is stored into lastBidTime
bid() writes lastBid with msg.value
bid() writes winning with msg.sender
bid() writes lastBidTime with block.timestamp
lastBid is used in the mul(105).div(100) minimum bid computation
bid() enforces the minimum bid arithmetic check
winning address receives the refund ETH inside bid()
lastBid amount is sent to the previous winner before state update
bid() executes the refund transfer before updating lastBid/winning/lastBidTime
block.timestamp gates the end() finalization conditions
ended flag is checked at the start of end()
lastBidTime is used in the end() timing condition
token address is used as the ERC1155 contract for safeTransferFrom in end()
winning address is the recipient of the ERC1155 transfer in end()
id is the ERC1155 token id transferred in end()
end() performs the ERC1155 safeTransferFrom external call before setting ended = true
contract balance is used in the div(20).mul(3) fee computation
end() computes the haus fee via division and multiplication
hausFee is transferred to haus via an external ETH send
haus address is the recipient of the fee transfer
end() executes haus.transfer before the ended flag is set
seller address is the recipient of the remaining balance
end() executes seller.transfer of the full balance before setting ended
end() sets ended = true
block.timestamp gates the pull() availability window
pull() requires lastBidTime == 0
token address is used as the ERC1155 contract for safeTransferFrom in pull()
seller address is the recipient of the ERC1155 transfer in pull()
id is the ERC1155 token id transferred in pull()
pull() performs the ERC1155 safeTransferFrom external call before setting ended = true
ERC1155 safeTransferFrom in end() invokes the receiver hook onERC1155Received on the winning address
ERC1155 safeTransferFrom in pull() invokes the receiver hook onERC1155Received
pull() sets ended = true
block.timestamp is compared against the auction timing in live()
lastBidTime is used in the live() time window check
bidLength is used in the live() time window check
startBidTime is used in the live() time window check
auctionLength is used in the live() time window check
block.timestamp guards the refund transfer to the previous winner in bid()
